turns.speaker: Student
turns.text: Please adopt the role of a belligerent husband, 'Jim', who's been nagged by his wife all morning and is fed up, and have a 1-paragraph dialogue with me, 'Jim's friend', while we're at the diner. Start with Jim saying, 'Gonna have to cut you off, buddy.' and respond accordingly.

turns.speaker: Steve
turns.text:
Jim: Gonna have to cut you off, buddy. I need to get home before I explode.  
Me: Jim, hey, calm down. Let’s just talk it out. What’s really on your mind?
